title: Outlook mobile: Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events on iOS and Android
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's plans and does not assume a calendar-specific default or enforcement mechanism. Corrections should complete the governance routes, cite Exchange rather than non-Microsoft application policy instructions, and distinguish published general DLP licensing from unpublished calendar-specific requirements.

claims.claim: The documented policy-tip policy can be targeted to individuals or groups.

claims.claim: The policy-tip setting is reached through Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Customization > Policy Management > Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips in Outlook.
claims.quote: Under Customization, select Policy Management. ... Open the configuration details of the policy configuration you want to change by selecting it. ... navigate to the Policies section
claims.fix: The automatic missing-word finding is not a setting-name error: the mobile reference contains the exact label. Complete the existing-configuration route as 'Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Policies > Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips in Outlook'. Keep the mobile reference as docs; the already-cited Cloud Policy overview documents the intervening configuration and Policies section.

Opened mobile policy-tip reference and Cloud Policy overview; the feature reference discusses email and does not connect the switch or targeting to calendar events.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy is the entry point for setting a DLP policy's mailbox scope and mode.
claims.quote: Go to Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy.
claims.fix: The printed steps correctly reach the policy-creation wizard, so this is an early-stopping path, not a wrong route. Replace controls[1].ui.docs with https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-policy-cc-email and cite it: that page documents the Exchange email location and Run the policy in simulation mode, whereas the existing reference is expressly for non-Microsoft app policies that cannot include Exchange or simulate. Keep the printed entry path and replace the note with 'Starts policy creation; select Exchange email for the location and choose the policy mode later in the wizard. The cmdlet runs in Security & Compliance PowerShell; -ExchangeLocation accepts only All. Calendar-specific behavior is not yet documented.'

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name <policy name> -ExchangeLocation All -Mode <PolicyMode> creates a DLP policy with Exchange email scope and the specified mode.
claims.quote: Use the New-DlpCompliancePolicy cmdlet to create data loss prevention (DLP) policies ... [-ExchangeLocation <MultiValuedProperty>] ... [-Mode <PolicyMode>] ... The Name parameter specifies the unique name of the DLP policy.

claims.claim: The ExchangeLocation parameter accepts only All, including email messages in the policy.
claims.quote: The ExchangeLocation parameter specifies whether to include email messages in the DLP policy. The valid value for this parameter is All.

claims.claim: The DLP policy Mode parameter supports Enable, Disable, TestWithNotifications and TestWithoutNotifications, including simulation with or without notifications.
